title: Emrys and the Room
author: Orsen Delacroix
blurb: Lena Eriksen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
